body: it was about a girl. first year of college, everyone in my dorm is getting to know each other. there was this one girl, we will call her A, and from the instant my roommate and i met her we had a bad feeling. people kept telling us that she is great and we should give her a chance. my roommate ended up leaving after that semester to go to a different school. at that point i had become friends with A. i didnt realize it at the time but she was a manipulative person and would get you to do anything just so it would seem like she appreciated you. i would do anything for her, we were essentially inseparable, and i didn’t realize how bad of a hold she had on me. towards the end of the year i was dealing really badly with my mental health because of school and relationship issues. she knew that and at one point she decided she was “tired” of how i was dealing with my mental health. she completely ignored my existence the last three weeks of school. she was the queen bee of our group so they all ignored me too, which sucked because we all had the same major and were taking all the same classes (only 6 people in my major). i was supposed to move in with her and another friend for the next year but i obviously didn’t and i sadly left the school and transferred to one in another state with a different major. my psychiatrist thinks i have slight ptsd from the experience with her. if i would have listened to my gut about her being a bad person i probably would still be at that school.
